# Scholastic Art Magazine

> > Educational magazine for middle and high school students featuring art history, studio projects, artist interviews, and creative careers.

Scholastic Art Magazine provides comprehensive art education content including historical movements, contemporary artists, hands-on studio projects, and career exploration. The magazine covers diverse topics from Indian art and Surrealism to graphic novels and sustainable art materials, serving grades 7-12.

## Key Topics

- Art History
- Studio Projects
- Artist Interviews
- Creative Process
- Visual Storytelling
- Portrait Art
- Contemporary Art
- Graphic Novels
- Art Careers
- Color Theory
- Art Materials
- Scholastic Art & Writing Awards
- Cultural Art Traditions
- Art Education
- Mixed Media

## Studio Projects & Lessons

- [Assemble a Portrait Studio Project Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2022-23/010123/assemble-a-portrait.html): Studio project: create portrait using mixed materials (grades 7-12)
- [Hero Portraits: Layers of Meaning Studio Project Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2025-26/120125/hero-portraits-layers-of-meaning.html): Studio project: layered mixed-media portrait of admired person

## Featured Issues & Art Movements

- [Surrealism: Where Dreams Meet Reality - December 2019](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2019-20/120119.html): Issue exploring Surrealism: Dalí, Varo, Kahlo & contemporary artists
- [Legacies of Indian Art Spotlight Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2019-20/010120/legacies-of-indian-art.html): Historical Indian art exploring Hinduism, Islam & Christianity influences
- [Industrial Inspiration Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2022-23/100122/industrial-inspiration.html): Charles Demuth's Precisionist paintings of 1920s industrial America
- [Coastal Customs Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2021-22/100121/coastal-customs.html): Northwest Coast indigenous art: Tlingit, Haida & formline techniques

## Artist Interviews & Profiles

- [Q&A With Bisa Butler Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2021-22/120121/bisa_butler_interview.html): Bisa Butler interview on quilting portraits with African textiles
- [Creating Colors for Artists Career Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2023-24/120123/creating-colors-for-artists.html): Joe Gyurcsak interview on paint development at Utrecht/Blick
- [Colossal Stage Design Career Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2023-24/090123/colossal-stage-design.html): Jacqui Pyle interview on art direction for TAIT live entertainment
- [Sculpting Chocolate Showpieces Career Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2024-25/100124/sculpting-chocolate-showpieces.html): Amaury Guichon interview on chocolate sculpting & Pastry Academy

## Visual Storytelling & Graphic Novels

- [Crash Course in Graphic Novels Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2024-25/010125/crash-course-in-graphic-novels.html): Guide to visual storytelling featuring Telgemeier & graphic novel creation
- [Comics: A Visual Style for Everyone Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2024-25/010125/comics-a-visual-style-for-everyone.html): Comic art techniques & narrative styles in graphic storytelling

## Art Techniques & Creative Process

- [Quick Sketches Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2023-24/090123/quick-sketches.html): Sketchbook techniques & visual voice development from da Vinci to today
- [Pattern Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2023-24/010124/pattern.html): Fashion design patterns featuring Kansai Yamamoto, Viktor&Rolf & van Gogh
- [Famous Faces Features Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2021-22/050122/famous-faces.html): Celebrity portraits from Marie Antoinette to Vogue photography
- [Inside Scoop: What is an Art Gallery? Art News Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2021-22/010122/inside-scoop-what-is-an-art-gallery.html): Art gallery guide featuring Gagosian, Pace & David Zwirner

## Student Artists & Awards

- [The Cycle of the Game Student Artist Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2025-26/120125/the-cycle-of-the-game.html): Justin Lee student artist interview on pastel composition & creative process
- [Glass Dreams Student Artist Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2019-20/030120/glass-dreams.html): Kiran Shere-Wolf's award-winning Wizard of Oz glass sculptures

## Optional

- [Goodbye Glitter? Debate Article for Students | Scholastic Art Magazine](https://art.scholastic.com/issues/2022-23/090122/goodbye-glitter.html): Environmental debate on glitter, microplastics & biodegradable alternatives
